name: UI: roll card gallery
description: One roll on the shared screen over a busy plate, with the narrator's box under it, for judging how a roll is displayed (crates/df-playground/src/roll.rs, kit/roll_card.rs). The card in this file plays once when the scene is loaded; development/playground-scripts/roll-gallery.txt rolls one of every kind and every die size in turn with fixed values (scene roll).

narration.speaker: Dungeon Master
narration.text: Athletics, Strength. The difficulty is fifteen. Roll the dice and let us see whether the rope holds.
